; Module names and their normalised form: <input> -> <normalised>.
; Normalised = file name only (everything up to the last \, / or $ is a directory),
; lower case, no .dll, no trailing "-" + text that starts with a digit.
; Shared by the Python test, the C++ loader and the PowerShell installer.

taskbar3-0.305 -> taskbar3

popup2 -> popup2

geekamp-1.9.7 -> geekamp
